title: WCL Mining Sirdar Mock Test 09
subtitle: Western Coalfields Limited — Mining Sirdar Recruitment
instructions: Select the best answer for each question

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A coal dust explosion can be initiated by
options: Overheating of a bearing in the roadway
Friction sparks from a dragging cable
Electrical failure of the surface plant
A methane explosion, spark, or flame
questions.solution: Methane explosion, spark, or flame can initiate it.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: When a man riding system breaks down, the operator must
options: Wait for the repair of the man riding system to finish
Let the passengers walk to the surface themselves
Arrange alternative safe means of transport or evacuation
The stopping of the persons at the top of the main mine shaft area
questions.solution: Alternative safe transport or evacuation must be arranged.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The shaft must be properly
options: It is kept completely free of all the fixtures
It is painted with the anti-corrosion paint only
It is lined with the bricks of the mine only
Fitted with guides or conductors for the cage or skip
questions.solution: Fitted with guides or conductors for the cage or skip.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, the sirdar must examine the working place in his district
options: At the commencement of each shift
Only when the inspector is on the mine
Only once in every week of the month
Only once in every calendar month
questions.solution: Regulation 129 of CMR 2017 (Examination by sirdars) requires the sirdar to inspect his district within two hours before the commencement of work in a shift and at least once in every four hours during the shift.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The water for dust suppression must be
options: Only the hot water that is used in the mine workings
The water from any source that is convenient to use
Clean and free from contaminants that could cause health hazards
Only the salt water that is found in the coastal mine workings there
questions.solution: Clean and free from contaminants.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'specific charge' in blasting is another term for
options: Number of holes
Blasting time
Total cost
Powder factor
questions.solution: Specific charge is synonymous with powder factor.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'post-blast muck pile' analysis helps to
options: Assess blast effectiveness and optimize future blasts
It is used for the stemming operations of the mine
It is used for the charging of the detonators
The measuring of the depth of the craters
questions.solution: Muck pile analysis assesses fragmentation and blast performance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'longwall method' differs from board and pillar by
options: Extracting coal in long faces without leaving pillars
The winning of coal from the shallow seams only
The using of the manual labour in the mine workings
The leaving of the coal in the pillars of a mine
questions.solution: Longwall extracts coal in long faces without permanent pillars.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'cycle time' for drifting includes
options: The time taken by the persons to reach the drift face
The life of the drilling machines that are used in mine
The number of the persons employed in the mine working sections daily
Drilling, charging, blasting, ventilation, scaling, and mucking
questions.solution: Drilling, charging, blasting, ventilation, scaling, and mucking.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ventilation duct' in a development heading must be
options: Extended to within 5 meters of the face
Control humidity in underground workings
It is optional in each mine heading
It is kept at the entrance only
questions.solution: Extended to within 5 meters of the face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'shock wave energy' of explosives contributes to
options: The displacement of the rock only
Initial rock fracturing and fragmentation
It is used for the charging of the detonators
It is used for the support of the roof
questions.solution: Shock wave energy provides initial fracturing of rock.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'pillar' in bord and pillar refers to
options: The roadway used for the haulage of coal
The pillar that is around the shaft only
The block of coal left to support the roof
The ventilation shaft of the mine workings
questions.solution: Block of coal left to support the roof.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mine water' can be harmful because it may contain
options: Acidic substances and dissolved minerals
The water that is pure and clean
The water of the freshly fallen rain
Nothing at all that is harmful to the men
questions.solution: May contain acidic substances and dissolved minerals.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'bearing' of a line in surveying is the
options: The angle between two traverse lines
The difference in level between points
The width of the chain used in the survey
Angle measured clockwise from north to the line
questions.solution: Angle measured clockwise from north to the line.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'caving method' in mining involves
options: The manual excavation of the coal seams by the hands of the workers
The keeping of the roof fully supported in the mine
Allowing roof to collapse in a controlled manner behind the face
The grouting of the void that is behind the working face
questions.solution: Controlled caving allows roof to collapse behind the working face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'material handling cost' per tonne is influenced by
options: The colour of the trucks that are used
Haul distance, road condition, truck payload
The brand of the drilling machine
The number of the benches that are mined
questions.solution: Material handling cost depends on distance, road, and payload.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire zone' in a mine must be
options: It is marked on the mine plan only
It is guarded by the mine fire brigade
It is kept open to all the persons
Clearly demarcated and access restricted
questions.solution: Clearly demarcated and access restricted.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'spill berms' at fuel storage serve to
options: The provision of the seating for the men
The increase in the storage of the fuel
Contain spills and prevent contamination
Store the rain water of the area
questions.solution: Spill berms contain fuel spills and prevent contamination.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'continuous miner' is used in which method?
options: Only in the shaft sinking operations
Room and pillar / bord and pillar
Only in the surface mining operations
Only in the longwall mining operations
questions.solution: Used in room and pillar method.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'overburden' in mining is
options: The mineral deposit of the mine
The rock below the deposit
The coal seam that is being mined
Material above the mineral deposit
questions.solution: Overburden is material above the mineral deposit.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'strata failure report' should include
options: The study of the rock mechanics of the mine strata
The investigation of the mineral deposits of that whole mining area here
Location, nature of failure, possible cause, and remedial measures
It applies only to the sedimentary rock strata of mine
questions.solution: Location, nature, cause, and remedial measures.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'CO2 flooding' in mines is used to
options: Inert atmosphere to extinguish fires
The increase of the air velocity in the mine
Dilute the poisonous mine gases
The increase of the oxygen in the mine air
questions.solution: CO2 flooding inert atmosphere to extinguish fires.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing training' for workers includes
options: No any training of the stowing work is needed at all
The reading of the safety rules of the mine company of that area alone
Safety procedures, equipment operation, and emergency response
The maintenance of the stowing records of the mine
questions.solution: Training covers safety, equipment operation, and emergency response.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'in situ' theory of coal formation suggests
options: Coal formed from volcanic activity
Coal formed from transported material
Coal formed from plants growing in place
Coal formed from marine organisms
questions.solution: In situ theory suggests coal formed from plants growing in place.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The Mines Act was enacted in
questions.solution: The Mines Act was enacted in 1952.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Water accumulation on benches creates hazards including
options: The improved visibility of the working benches
The better compaction of the surface benches
No hazards at all for the mining equipment
Reduced traction, slope instability, equipment damage
questions.solution: Water accumulation causes multiple hazards.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding vehicle must be equipped with
options: A fuel tank gauge and a headlight only
A spare tyre and a small toolbox
Headlights, horn, and braking system
A music system fitted inside the cars
questions.solution: Headlights, horn, and braking system.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing gallery' is a
options: Prepared opening through which stowing material is delivered to goaf
A gallery that houses the mine winding engines of the open cast pit mine
A ventilation shaft of the underground mine workings
A water gallery that is placed at the surface of mine
questions.solution: Prepared opening for delivering stowing material to goaf.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire breathing apparatus' for mine rescue includes
options: Self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA) for firefighters
The ordinary dust masks that are sold in market
No any such apparatus is needed here at all
A simple cloth that is wrapped around the face of the fire fighter
questions.solution: SCBA provides breathing apparatus for fire rescue.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'air velocity' in intake airways must not be less than
options: 1 m/s
5 m/s
questions.solution: Must not be less than 0.25 m/s.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'barometer' in a mine is used to measure
options: Atmospheric pressure
Voltage measurement only
Temperature of the strata
Air velocity
questions.solution: Measures atmospheric pressure.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The safety device to prevent overwinding in a shaft is called
options: The brake lever of the winding engine
Governor or overwinding prevention device
The signal bell that is fitted in the shaft
The safety catch that is fitted on the cage
questions.solution: A governor or overwinding prevention device is used.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'air crossing' in mines is used to
options: The increase of the dust concentration in mine
The crossing of the two air currents
Allow two air currents to cross without mixing
The blocking of the mine ventilation
questions.solution: Air crossings allow air currents to cross without mixing.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, survey instruments at a mine shall be:
options: They are checked and calibrated once in every year by the mine survey staff of mine
They are replaced once in every six months of a year by the owner of mine
They are checked only by the Inspector of the mines of the region here
Checked, maintained and calibrated at regular intervals as specified by the manufacturer
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 67(2): survey instruments are checked, maintained and calibrated at intervals specified by the manufacturer.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'date and time' in a report are important for
options: The number of the persons employed only here
The name of the colliery only in the report
Establishing the sequence of events and timeline
The quantity of the coal that is produced
questions.solution: Establishing the sequence of events and timeline.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Every mine plan or section under CMR 2017 shall show:
options: The line of the grid system that is used in the mine plan
The magnetic meridian without the date and the year of the survey work
The railway alignment of the mine surface workings area
The true north, or the magnetic meridian with the date of the latter
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 64(1)(b): plans show true north or magnetic meridian and the date of the later.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'dip and strike' measurements define
options: Orientation of geological features in three dimensions
The vertical extent of the coal seam in mine
The cost of the survey instrument that is used
The tonnage of the coal that is in the panel
questions.solution: Dip and strike define 3D orientation of geological features.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: When workings extend to within 60 m of the settled boundary with an adjacent mine, the owner/agent/manager shall:
options: The informing of the labour union of the mine and also of the owners of the mining area
Inform the adjacent mine and give its surveyors reasonable facilities for surveys
The stopping of all the mine work in the underground mine workings
The sealing of the mine workings in the whole surface mining area
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 65(8): the adjacent mine is informed and its surveyors are given reasonable facilities for required surveys and levellings.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'cross-section' of a drift or tunnel shows
options: The length of the roadway that has been driven
The gradient of the floor of the mine roadways
The shape and dimensions of the opening at a particular point
The number of the props that are set in the mine roadways of area
questions.solution: Shape and dimensions at a particular point.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maximum gradient for a man riding rope haulage is
options: 1 in 3
1 in 5
1 in 10
1 in 2
questions.solution: The maximum gradient is 1 in 3.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A dumper in open cast mining transports
options: Persons from the shaft bottom to the surface
Drill rods from the workshop to the face
Overburden and coal from face to dump or coal depot
The stone dust from the surface store of mine
questions.solution: Transports overburden and coal.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire safety audit' in mines should cover
options: Only the records of the past accidents of that whole coal mine area
No any such audit of the fire safety is needed
Detection systems, suppression, escape routes, and training
Only the working condition of the fire appliances
questions.solution: Fire audits cover detection, suppression, escape, training.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The water-danger plan maintained under CMR 2017 shows water bodies existing within ______ of the boundary of the mine.
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 65(1)(g): a water-danger plan and section show water bodies existing up to 200 m of the mine boundary.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mine survey regulations' require
options: The recording of the temperature variations of mine
Prepare plans only when demanded by the inspector
No any such regulations are required
Regular surveys and plan updates as prescribed
questions.solution: Regulations require regular surveys and plan updates.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maximum speed for winding persons in a shaft is
options: 12 m/s
5 m/s
8 m/s
2 m/s
questions.solution: Maximum speed for winding persons is 12 m/s as per regulations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An 'anticline' in geology is
options: Downward fold in rock layers
Upward fold in rock layers
A type of the mineral deposit
A type of the fault in the rock
questions.solution: Anticline is an upward fold in rock layers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'support inspection report' must mention
options: The number of the mine supports that are required in the next month
The colour of the wooden roof props that are used
The depth of the mine shaft that is sunk in the area
Type, condition, and adequacy of support in the working area
questions.solution: Type, condition, and adequacy of support.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'air blast' from mining explosions can damage
options: Used for rock bolting operations
Used for charging detonators
Nearby structures if not controlled
Improve the ventilation in the mine
questions.solution: Air blast can damage structures if not properly controlled.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Carbon dioxide (CO2) in mines can accumulate in
options: Low-lying areas and poorly ventilated sections
The mouth of the intake shaft of mine
It reduces the air velocity below the limits
The highest point of the coal seam in mine
questions.solution: Low-lying areas and poorly ventilated sections.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The earthing of electrical equipment in mines is important to
options: The reduction of the cost of cable installation
Prevent electric shock and reduce risk of ignition
The determination of the direction of the seam
Increase the voltage carrying capacity
questions.solution: Prevent electric shock and reduce risk of ignition.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'road condition monitoring' includes
options: A single pre-monsoon check of the roads
A single inspection that is done annually
Regular checking of surface, drainage, signage
Estimation by the dumper drivers only
questions.solution: Road monitoring checks surface, drainage, signage.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The first-aid box in a mine must contain
options: The directory of the mine telephones
The spare bulbs for the cap lamp of men
Prescribed medicines and equipment for first aid
The forms of the accident register of mine
questions.solution: Prescribed medicines and equipment for first aid.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The joint survey plan showing workings near the common boundary with an adjacent mine shall be signed by:
options: The surveyors and managers of both the mine and the adjacent mine
The surveyor of the mine that is concerned with it only
Only the Chief Inspector of the mines of that coal mining region state
The district magistrate of the coal mining district
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 65(1)(e): the joint survey plan is signed by the surveyor and the manager of the mine and of adjoining mines whose workings come within 60 m of the common boundary.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Grade control in opencast mining ensures
options: The minimum number of the workers at the mine face
Mineral quality meets specifications through selective mining
The maximum profit that is earned by the mining company
The maximum use of the mining equipment in the coal mine workings
questions.solution: Grade control ensures quality through selective mining.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In a rope haulage man riding system, the rope must be tested
options: Only once in every calendar year
At regular intervals as prescribed
Daily before every journey
At the time of installation
questions.solution: Regular testing at prescribed intervals is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must maintain a record of
options: The quantity of the explosives that are used
Persons employed, time of work, and safety conditions
The daily output of the coal that is mined
The wages that are paid to the mine workers
questions.solution: Records include persons employed, work time, and safety conditions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Intrinsically safe equipment is designed to
options: The increase of the temperature of the mine air in the area
The production of more and more sparks in the circuit of mine
It can work at any voltage without any kind of the protection in the mine
Not produce sparks or heat sufficient to ignite methane or coal dust
questions.solution: Not produce sparks or heat sufficient to ignite methane or coal dust.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stope' in mining refers to
options: A horizontal roadway driven between two shafts
An underground excavation from which ore or coal is extracted
A vertical opening that is raised from a lower level
An open bench that is worked in the surface stone quarry of mines
questions.solution: Underground excavation for extraction.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'profile leveling' determines
options: The monitoring of the gas concentrations
Elevations along a predetermined line
The horizontal distance of the lines
Record temperature variations
questions.solution: Profile leveling determines elevations along a line.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'reaming' in raise boring enlarges
options: The ventilation duct
The haulage roadway
The sump
The pilot hole
questions.solution: Reaming enlarges the pilot hole to the full diameter of the raise.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'sapropelic coal' is formed from
options: Algae and spores
The bark in a swamp
River detritus only
The weathered rock
questions.solution: Sapropelic coal forms from algae and spores.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'sectional area' of a roadway is important for
options: The tonnage of coal in the district
It is independent of the mine layout
The age of the roof strata of the mine
Ventilation calculations and support design
questions.solution: Ventilation calculations and support design.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'water curtain' or 'grouting' is used to
options: The increase of the depth of the mine workings
The increase of the water inflow in the mine
Seal off water-bearing zones and reduce water inflow
The improvement of the lighting in the workings
questions.solution: Seals off water-bearing zones and reduces water inflow.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'pilot tunnel' or 'pilot drift' is driven to
options: Explore geological conditions ahead of the main drift
The provision of the underground accommodation
It serves as the main ore pass of the mine
The storage of the explosives underground
questions.solution: Explores geological conditions ahead.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'five-day accident investigation report' must be submitted
options: Within one month of the accident
Within 5 days of the accident
Only after five days of the accident
Only after five months of the event
questions.solution: Within 5 days of the accident.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Shot firing in gassy mines requires
options: Permit entry without any examination
No any special precautions are needed
Gas testing before and during shot firing
The blasting without any stemming of the hole
questions.solution: Gas testing is mandatory before and during shot firing in gassy mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must ensure that the lighting in the working place
options: Is adequate for safe working
Is only at the entrance
It is not needed at all in mine
Is switched off after dusk
questions.solution: Adequate lighting for safe working is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'differential leveling' determines
options: The temperature of the mine air
The pressure of the ground at the mine
The horizontal distance of the line
Height difference between two points
questions.solution: Differential leveling determines height differences.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A dragline in open cast mining is used for
options: Benching hard rock ahead of the drilling fleet
Stripping overburden from large areas
Loading coal into railway wagons
Dredging overburden from a district sump
questions.solution: Strips overburden from large areas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing water management' is important because
options: Excess water affects stability and environmental conditions
Only the pressure of the mine pump really matters
Only the water pumps that are at the surface need the attention
The water of the mine does not affect the goaf
questions.solution: Water management is important for stability and environment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Plans and sections required under CMR 2017 shall be corrected and maintained up-to-date at intervals not exceeding:
options: 1 month
6 months
1 year
3 months
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 64(4): plans are kept corrected up-to-date not earlier than 3 months.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'exploration borehole' near old workings is done to
options: Investigate water conditions before mining approaches
The measuring of the wind velocity in the mine
The determination of the price of the coal
The extraction of the coal from the coal seam
questions.solution: Exploration boreholes investigate water conditions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire department coordination' for mines includes
options: Pre-planned response, access routes, and communication
The painting of the fire points of the mine working areas
It is optional only for the smaller mines
No any such coordination is needed at all
questions.solution: Coordination includes pre-planned response, access, communication.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar shall not permit work in any place where
options: The ventilation of the working place is adequate
The floor of the working place is very dry and quite safe here
The roof of the working place is well supported
There is likelihood of danger from roof, floor, or sides
questions.solution: Work shall not be permitted where there is likelihood of danger.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The shearer drum speed is typically
options: 500 rpm
10 rpm
100 rpm
questions.solution: Typically 20-40 rpm.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'survey equipment calibration' is important because
options: The testing of the roof stability
Ensures accuracy of measurements
A one-time factory calibration
Inspection once in ten years
questions.solution: Calibration ensures measurement accuracy.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Unless otherwise approved, mine plans and sections under CMR 2017 shall be prepared on a scale with a representative factor of:
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 64(1)(d): plans are on a scale with RF 2000:1 or 1000:1, with a scale bar at least 25 cm long.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In the 'longwall method', coal is extracted from
options: The isolated panels only
A pillar left between the two
The floor level of workings
A long continuous face
questions.solution: From a long continuous face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'corrective action' in a report should be
options: Specific with responsible person and target completion date
It is quite general and without any of the detail
It is only repeated from the earlier report of mine
It is vague and open to any interpretation of the persons there
questions.solution: Specific with responsible person and target completion date.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'main roof' in coal mines refers to
options: The surface of the ground above the seam
The immediate roof that is above the face
The floor of the coal seam that is being mined
The stronger, thicker strata above the immediate roof
questions.solution: Main roof is the stronger strata above the immediate roof.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A bar chart shows coal production: Q1=100, Q2=120, Q3=150, Q4=130. Total annual production?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Antonym of 'Benevolent' is
options: Charitable
Generous
Kind
Malevolent
questions.solution: Malevolent is opposite of benevolent.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'automatic fire detection' systems in mines use
options: Manual patrolling by night guards
Visual inspection by the overman
A single water alarm at the surface
Smoke, heat, and gas sensors
questions.solution: Smoke, heat, and gas sensors.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'PM-KUSUM' scheme in coal areas provides
options: Solar energy solutions for farmers and rural areas
The construction of the new coal washeries
The expansion of the railway network in mine
The deep sea fishing schemes of the area
questions.solution: Solar energy solutions.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'clean coal technology' aims to
options: Reduce environmental impact of coal use
Reduce the moisture in the coal seams
Increase the ash content of the coal
Reduce the calorific value of the coal
questions.solution: Clean coal technologies reduce environmental impact.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Coal Mines (Nationalisation) Act' was enacted in
questions.solution: Enacted in 1973.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: If 20% of a number is 50, the number is

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) was established in
questions.solution: ISRO was established in 1969.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Which acid is found in vinegar?
options: Citric acid
Lactic acid
Tartaric acid
Acetic acid
questions.solution: Acetic acid is found in vinegar.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'PM-KISAN' scheme provides
options: Direct income support to farmers
A housing scheme for urban poor
Loans for small industries
Subsidy for electric vehicles
questions.solution: Direct income support to farmers.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Singareni Collieries Company Limited' is located in
options: Telangana
Jharkhand
Odisha
Maharashtra
questions.solution: SCCL is in Telangana.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The largest freshwater lake in India is
options: Wular Lake
Loktak Lake
Dal Lake
Chilika Lake
questions.solution: Wular Lake is the largest freshwater lake.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: In a family, there are 4 sons and 3 sisters. Each son has 2 sisters. How many children are there in total?
questions.solution: 4 sons + 3 sisters = 7 children.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'moisture content' of coal is important because
options: It affects the calorific value and handling properties
It decides the price of the coal of mine
It fixes the grade of the coal seam of mine
It is only a measurement that is done in the laboratory
questions.solution: Affects calorific value and handling.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'mine closure planning' in India follows
options: The Payment of Wages Act only
The Workmen's Compensation Act
The Factories Act of the state only
MMDR Act and CMR 2017 requirements
questions.solution: MMDR Act and CMR 2017 requirements.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'adit' in mining is a
options: An inclined opening that is driven from the surface of the mine workings
Horizontal or near-horizontal opening from the surface into a hillside
A vertical opening that is sunk from the surface of the pit
The surface extraction of the minerals in the open pit
questions.solution: Horizontal opening from surface into a hillside.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Environmental Impact Assessment' (EIA) for mining projects is mandatory under
options: The Mines Act 1952 alone only
Environment Protection Act 1986
Forest Conservation Act 1980
Land Acquisition Act 1894
questions.solution: EIA is mandatory under EPA 1986 for mining projects.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'compensation for land acquisition' for mining is governed by
options: The Coal Mines Act 1971 only
The Environment Protection Act 1986
The Minimum Wages Act 1948
